## 1) Key file paths (player input)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scripts\Player.gd` | Movement: `Input.is_action_pressed("ui_*")` plus raw `KEY_A/D/W/S` in `_physics_process`. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scripts\GameController.gd` | Prototype room loop: `KEY_R`/`KEY_I`, dialogue advance (`ui_accept`, Enter, Space, Tab for skip), `_try_interact()` on accept while not in dialogue. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.1_SchoolExterior.gd` | `_unhandled_input`: door scene change when `KEY_E`/Space/Enter and player overlaps door `Area2D`. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\ui\TopDialogueOverlay.gd` | `_input`: `KEY_TAB` skips typewriter while bar visible. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd` | `_unhandled_input`: only dismisses round-winnings overlay (Space / any mouse press). Core spins are **not** started from global input here. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test.gd` | Editor/play harness: `Button.pressed` → `combat.spin()`, bet steppers, `combat.choose_free_spins_princess(...)`. This is the main **click-to-spin** path. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\GameManager.gd` | `handle_puzzle_input(player_answer, ...)` — text/puzzle style input (export/reference side of the tree). |

`1.2_Corridor.gd` has no input handling (only dialogue tween / flicker).

---

## 2) Automated tests / simulations (existing)

| Path | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\test\scene_smoke_check.gd` | `extends SceneTree`: loads and instantiates a fixed list of `.tscn` (menu, Arc_1/2 scenes, `combat_root`, `combat_test`), waits `ready`, then frees — **smoke only**. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\determinism_check.gd` | Two passes of 100× `CombatRoot.spin_sync()` with fixed seed; compares serialized snapshots + princess rotation. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\princess_check.gd` | Large suite: instantiates `CombatRoot`, drives grids/spins/goal/free-spin APIs directly (mix of `spin()` and sync paths per assertion). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\test\rtp_audit.gd` | Monte Carlo RTP / encounter stats; prints `RTP_AUDIT_JSON ...`. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd` | `_is_headless_runtime()` (DisplayServer `"headless"`) disables heavy FX in `_ready` — supports headless combat runs. |

`tools/scene_builder/*.py` and `tools/qa/update_qa_analytics.py` are **not** gameplay simulators; QA analytics is log post-processing.

---

## 3) Gaps for “scripted bots” simulating player input over time

- **No shared input layer**: Gameplay reads `Input` directly or uses `_unhandled_input`/`_input` with hard-coded keys. There is no `InputMap.action_press` / `parse_input_event()` pipeline or injectable `InputProvider` for tests.
- **Split paradigms**: Combat in practice is **API + UI** (`combat_test` buttons vs `spin_sync()` / internal methods). A bot either duplicates API calls (like `princess_check`) or must synthesize `InputEvent`s and route them through the viewport — not standardized today.
- **Exploration / narrative untested**: No headless script walks the player, triggers `1.1_SchoolExterior` door overlap + key press, or steps through `GameController` interact states.
- **`scene_smoke_check`**: No frames of movement, dialogue, or combat loop — only instantiate/ready.
- **Async vs sync**: `spin()` is async with timers/FX; `spin_sync()` is the deterministic shortcut. Long “play the combat UI” scenarios need careful awaiting or sticking to sync/API.

---

## 4) Headless / CI entrypoints

- **Documented runner** (rubric / `combat/VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md`):  
  `tools/cmd/godot.cmd --headless --path AXEL/axel_project -s res://<script>.gd`  
  Scripts: `combat/test/princess_check.gd`, `combat/test/determinism_check.gd`, `combat/test/rtp_audit.gd`, `test/scene_smoke_check.gd`.
- **No `.github` workflows or `*.yml` CI** were found under `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot` in this workspace — automation is **local/scripted Godot invocations**, not wired CI in-repo.

---

**Bottom line:** Combat already has strong **headless, code-driven** simulation via `CombatRoot` + `*_check.gd` / `rtp_audit.gd`. **Overworld / dialogue / interaction** paths are still **manual-Input-shaped** with almost no automated “playthrough” coverage; a bot layer would benefit from centralizing input or driving the same public methods the tests use instead of only polling `Input`.
